subject: Next steps: evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive availability
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Reeves <daniel@opticorehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery recap & proposed next steps (evaluation kickoff + tech deep dive)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard from OptiCore:
- Primary goal: Reduce manual chart extraction time and improve downstream coding accuracy for outpatient encounters.
- Key success metrics: entity-extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the selected prompt set; 99th-percentile inference latency < 600ms for 2k-token requests; and <1.5% hallucination rate on structured outputs.
- Data: average record size ~2,100 tokens; mix of structured fields + free-text notes.
- Security: HIPAA-sensitive, plan to use a private deployment/sandbox for evaluation.

Proposed next steps (two small asks):
1) Schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive + demo for the product and engineering teams (we recommend 90 minutes if your engineers want to review integration/infra). Topics: deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), prompt engineering walkthrough, sample prompt set, and baseline performance expectations.
2) Kick off the evaluation (2-week trial) with a brief mutual action plan (MAP) that captures success metrics, roles, data access, and deliverables. I attached a one-page trial charter and a small sample prompt pack to accelerate prep.

Proposed slots for the tech deep dive (all PT):
- Tue Jul 6 — 10:00–11:30am
- Wed Jul 7 — 2:00–3:30pm
- Thu Jul 8 — 9:00–10:30am

If none of those work, send 2–3 alternative windows and we’ll adjust.

Quick asks before the deep dive (save time during the call):
- Please confirm which environments your team can provision (test EHR extract or S3 sandbox) and any compliance guardrails we should be aware of.
- Share a small sample (redacted) record or one-off examples we can run through the prompt set (CSV/PARQUET OK).

Attachments (stubs):
- OptiCore-trial-charter-20270701.docx (trial charter, includes MAP + success metrics)
- opticore_prompt_samples.csv (10 example prompts + expected outputs)

I’ve cc’d Marissa (our AE lead) to track dates and logistics. Ben will lead the technical deep dive if we lock a time — I’ll loop him in once you pick a slot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you into a sandbox.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0163

---

Karthik —

Appreciate the recap, that matches our notes. A few clarifications and availability: 

Availability for the deep dive (our team) — PT:
- Mon Jul 12 — 10:00–11:30am (preferred)
- Wed Jul 14 — 9:00–10:30am

We do typically prefer a 90-minute slot so our engineering and security folks can both attend.

Success metric clarification: the F1 target is reasonable; our additional internal constraint is end-to-end pipeline latency (including our pre/post-processing) — we’ll want to see a baseline measured against our 2,000–2,500 token batch.

Security: Sophie (cc’d) is our security lead — she’ll want details on the sandbox environment and a copy of your SOC2 and data handling notes. We prefer a private sandbox for the trial if that’s available. Also curious if you support customer-managed keys (KMS) for the private deployment.

I can confirm we’ll try to provide a small redacted sample by next Tue.

Daniel Reeves
